chapter_title: Part I, Chapter 2 -- Design Related Project Level Pavement Management

sections.title: Relationship of Design to Pavement Management
sections.summary: Frames structural design as one component (the 'structural subsystem') of a broader project-level pavement management system (PMS); design outputs feed network-level PMS decisions on pavement type selection and program-level resource allocation.
sections.body: This chapter (condensed; see the printed guide, Section 2, pdf_page ~29-40, printed I-31 to I-39, for full detail) situates the design procedures of Parts II-III within the broader practice of pavement management, describing the Guide as providing the structural design subsystem for a state's project-level PMS, and how pavement-type-selection and network-level management decisions relate to (and are informed by) project-level structural design outputs.
key_points: Structural design is one subsystem within a broader project-level pavement management system (PMS)
This Guide provides the structural design methodology for that PMS
Pavement type selection and network-level management are related but distinct decision processes
sections.applicability: Organizational/process context; not a source of numeric design inputs (condensed chapter, low priority relative to Parts II design equations).
